response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development with strong proficiency in C, C++, and embedded systems, as demonstrated during their tenure at National Instruments. However, their resume lacks direct experience with critical security technologies (e.g., MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection) and networking technologies (e.g., Layer-2/3, switch operation) required for this role. Additionally, there is no evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is a mandatory requirement.
strengths: Strong C and C++ experience with embedded systems development
Demonstrated ability to work across full software development lifecycle
Proficient in Linux and hardware development environments
concerns: No direct experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.)
No documented experience with networking technologies (Layer-2/3, switch operation)
No evidence of Japanese language proficiency
